name: Agent-Mem0-cover_blocks-paired-smoke
planner: project Agent + StructuredPlanner + Codex gpt-5.5 medium
primary_metric: official environment eval_success; include failures in denominator
limitations: Smoke test only; no statistical success-rate claim

Agent receives measured simulator predicates and initial RGB memory

handoff_validation.goal: complete IK approach then frozen official VLA execution in one persistent world
limitations: Not an isolated Agent ablation; rendering, memory and numerical execution changed relative to historical trials.
smoke-05 uses Conv3D and CPU readback; smoke-06 linear and CPU; smoke-07/08 linear and CUDA.
Both seeds have the same initial color layout; no changed-layout generalization claim.
Agent recovery gain requires episodes that actually trigger recovery plus a matched control.
smoke-08 exposes a missing Codex handoff schema; fixed in 1191583. smoke-09 completed without triggering review, so no in-rollout recovery benefit is established.
